verdict.rationale: The docs describe capturing custom events "from any SDK". The AI wizard "instruments the PostHog SDKs client-side and server-side" across 26+ documented frameworks and languages, and an HTTP capture API covers any other language. A hands-on user reports straightforward integration with a Swift iOS app, and session replay is documented for both websites and mobile apps. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party list of official SDKs by language and platform (e.g. JS, iOS, Android, Python, Node, Go), and documented backend SDK coverage beyond the wizard's general server-side claim.
